variants.title: 眠らない街の屋根裏薬房
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE full-bleed tall portrait illustration, 9:19.5 iPhone aspect ratio, completed rank-5 magical potion workshop for a lofi focus app.
Input image 1: the overly sparse previous workshop, a subject reference to substantially improve. Input image 2: definitive PIXEL ART STYLE reference of rooftop working girl; match its clustered pixels, stepped contours, atmospheric depth, indigo-violet shadows, amber lamp glow and restrained teal accents. Render the woman with the same pixels as the scenery, not smooth anime.
USER FEEDBACK: initial giant factories were too cluttered; last empty room was too sterile and sparse. Find the middle, with a strong EMOTIONAL CHILL LOFI atmosphere. Make a place the viewer wants to stay in at 2 am. Quietly lived-in, nostalgic, intimate, gently magical. No enormous blank wall, no empty top half. Rich layers of space and meaningful everyday details, grouped into readable silhouettes, not tiny objects everywhere.
One modest but lovingly developed potion workshop, a mature personal workplace, not a multistorey factory. A coherent elegant copper/glass brewing apparatus with soft mint liquid at left; a worn oak writing/working desk at lower right. Shelves with a restrained selection of bottles and dog-eared books, trailing herb plants, a knitted throw over the chair, open handwritten notebook with no legible text, a small radio, warm desk lamp. Some equipment and shelves have clearly been added over time. Cool quiet distance contrasts with intimate amber foreground. Girl dark-haired tied loosely back, small supporting figure max15% image height, quietly doing her potion-making job, checking notes and a flask, not looking at viewer. Environment is protagonist, thoughtful casual posture, not glamour character design. Preserve breathing room between detail groups. Window view should be a major atmospheric feature, with foreground plants framing it. Natural occlusion and depth, no diagram or cutaway look. Visible pixel art finish not watercolor or smooth painterly rendering. No UI, borders, status bar, labels, watermark, collage, giant woman, silver bob, sprawling pipe maze, dozens of glowing tanks, flat empty studio backdrop.
SCENE A: Cozy attic apothecary overlooking a sleepy fantasy town at deep blue hour. A large broad multi-pane dormer window fills the upper-middle, showing overlapping tiled roofs, a few warm distant windows, narrow chimney smoke drifting into a violet sky and a distant clock tower silhouette. The window is slightly ajar with a soft curtain, herbs trail from a shelf at its edge. Sloped wooden ceiling and shelves on left frame the view. Workbench runs under window, brewing apparatus on left, girl seated lower right with a cardigan loosely over her practical apron. Warm lamp pools and subtle mint flask light, muted plum shadows, dusty amber reflections on old floor. Medium detail density, inviting lofi album-cover mood.
